title: TOTUM63 Table4 A:D source-row preservation and adequacy specification
status: Source-row adequacy selection frozen before numeric-row inspection; methods/header-informed, not trial preregistration or independent validation.

receipts.sanitization: Only workbook final-URL signed query omitted; stable requested URL, actual acquisition times, byte hashes and ignored exact raw-receipt SHA retained.

access.acquisition_scope: The unrestricted public source workbook was acquired and may contain released deidentified individual values. Full clinical histories, unique participant identity/coverage and within-person row pairing remain unverified. No clinical numerical records have been inspected and no participant/source-row dump was created.

selection.row_scan: All selected-column positions from first_source_row through the maximum of declared worksheet dimension and selected-column cells. Retain absent positions/all-empty layout rows separately; no clinical participant denominator inferred.
selection.no_other_numeric_outcomes: Never read other worksheet outcomes or numeric values outside A:D. Other workbook-level structure may be checked only for source integrity and selected-range resolution.

source_row_contract.unit: source worksheet row; not a verified participant or unique person
source_row_contract.within_row_relation: C and D are source-layout associated baseline/follow-up fields; same-person pairing remains unverified. Preserve association without inventing participant identity.
source_row_contract.A: Opaque raw group cell; source arm membership/individual randomization is not independently certified.
source_row_contract.B: Opaque source glycemic-status label; no diagnostic category, type/history, latent-state or baseline clinical classification inferred.

D.nominal_assessment: 6 months (source D3); Methods describe V3 at nominal24weeks with +/-5days. These planned/presentation labels do not establish actual collection time.
D.actual_collection_time: unknown; planned schedule does not verify actual collection or impose a realized interval

source_row_contract.local_provenance: Library may retain workbook SHA, worksheet/row/column and raw cell observations in memory or ignored local intake storage; public CLI/report never exports rows, values, IDs or raw unexpected strings.
clinical_unknowns: same-person pairing and unique participant identity

raw_cell_preservation.formula: Retain formula/cached-type existence locally; never execute or treat cached result as laboratory evidence.
raw_cell_preservation.blank: Distinguish absent cell, explicit blank, empty text and all-empty layout row where OOXML supports that distinction. No missing→zero.
raw_cell_preservation.numeric: Distinguish positive finite, zero, negative and nonfinite numbers. No zero/negative/nonfinite value treated as blank or as a clinical state. Positive finite is not a laboratory-validity claim.
raw_cell_preservation.date: Detect explicit date cell or numeric cell with date-formatted style; retain opaque date/serial, never glucose or inferred visit time.
raw_cell_preservation.text: Retain as opaque text/unknown marker. Do not coerce numeric-looking strings, parse undocumented clinical codes or assign negative-test/absent-event meanings.
raw_cell_preservation.error: Preserve source Excel error kind; no clinical missingness/withdrawal/death reason assigned.
raw_cell_preservation.merged_A_B: Detect selected-body merges and unresolved anchors; do not propagate arm/status labels to adjacent rows.

allowed: source/protocol/receipt integrity checks and implementation provenance
counts of raw selected-cell kinds per A/B/C/D
counts of positive finite/zero/negative/nonfinite numeric FPG cells separately
counts of same-row raw C/D kind-combinations; explicitly not verified paired participants
count of all-empty A:D layout rows separately from nonempty source records
counts of source-body merge structures and missing/unresolved group cells
count of distinct nonempty textual A group tokens and frequency for source-reviewed safe labels only
explicit unknown requirements and clinical-fit/activation refusal
safe_aggregate_outputs.group_label_normalization: Unicode whitespace collapse only; raw original retained locally. No case folding, alias guessing, forward fill or inferred numeric-code mapping. Unrecognized labels summarized by counts only, never raw strings.
safe_aggregate_outputs.B_status_output: Only raw-kind/empty/distinct-token coverage; no status labels, diagnostic strata or clinical categories exported.
forbidden: individual FPG values or numeric ranges
FPG sums, means, distributions, changes, correlations or treatment contrasts
thresholds, inferred diagnoses, negative tests, remission or latent clinical states
clinical likelihood, hazard/dose/lag fit, causal effect or national activation

derived_counts: Counts are reproducible source-layout/type coverage diagnostics, not clinical outcomes, sample-size certification, efficacy estimates or evidence of missing-at-random. Unknowns are never zero/pass.

source_choice_and_possible_future_estima.choice_rationale: Choose only same-sheet A:D because it is the public source field surface for the blinded trial primary FPG baseline/end-of-treatment endpoint, before any local numeric outcomes were inspected. No effect direction used to select columns or groups. All selected source-arm rows are retained, including the exploratory open-label BID arm; no efficacy comparison is made.
source_choice_and_possible_future_estima.identified_now: Source-row/type/layout adequacy only. No clinical or participant endpoint distribution is accepted at this stage.
source_choice_and_possible_future_estima.future_restricted_target: If a separate reviewed contract establishes same-person row pairing, unique/exchangeable record units, raw-value validity and missing semantics, the empirical distribution of source baseline/follow-up FPG among available pairs by assigned arm may be estimated. Its available-pair mean change/absolute contrast would be conditional on observation, not automatically the full randomized effect.
source_choice_and_possible_future_estima.materiality: This is useful as an intake/measurement-preservation gate only. It does not justify another effect benchmark or close the longitudinal clinical observation contract. Reuse existing observation-preservation concepts rather than invent an engine state mapping.

source_conflicts: Main Dataavailability says source file contains all collected deidentified IPD; ReportingSummaryp1 describes source data for tables/figures and request access for generated/analyzed clinical data. Preserve conflict; actual selected field coverage governs.

Main Outcomes and ReportingSummaryp5 omit V4 and pharmacotherapy-requirement timing; source registration defines treatment need as investigator withdrawal. Unknown actual stopping process blocks default independent censoring/MAR.
ReportingSummaryp2 says no data excluded; this does not certify no missing visits or complete outcome ascertainment.

No public row-identity/missing-code dictionary, workbook comments/named tables/defined names or attached ClinicalTrials protocol/SAP document was found. Header adjacency is not unique-person certification.
Registration lists three glycemic categories; main exploratory analysis uses four. No category conversion in this audit.

Cached ClinicalTrials protocolSection.ipdSharingStatementModule.ipdSharing is NO, while publication Dataavailability advertises indefinite deidentified IPD release. The separately verified public Figsharev1 CC BY4.0 release license remains valid; registration does not certify row identity or complete clinical coverage.
Publication Statistics describes an LOCF sensitivity analysis; the adequacy intake performs no imputation and does not adopt that method as a missingness assumption.

failure_dispositions.hash_header_scope_drift: Stop intake; do not repair source cells, select a convenient alternate sheet or expand scope.
failure_dispositions.unknown_group_or_missing_marker: Preserve unresolved raw status locally and aggregate count; block dependent interpretation.
failure_dispositions.formula_date_boolean_zero_negative_nonfi: Keep separate raw kind; no silent coercion, filtering or clinical interpretation.
failure_dispositions.all_empty_row: Count as layout/empty source position, never lost participant.
failure_dispositions.pairing_identity_treatment_death_unknown: Retain source-layout observations; no clinical participant history, likelihood or fit-ready claim.
failure_dispositions.insufficient_source_layout: Return an inadequate/unresolved source decision; do not create a convenience efficacy benchmark.

used_source_chronology: Prior cached Figshare metadata title/rights/file identity inspected; no workbook outcomes.

Live metadata, Methods/Outcomes/Statistics/sample-size assumptions, Dataavailability/Rights and registration protocolSection inspected; abstract/results/discussion and registration resultsSection not printed. Prior-pilot assumptions in methods are used-source context.
Header-only plan recorded before workbook download; source bytes pinned. Workbook structure and string-only header bands inspected under dated amendments; numeric/mixed data rows excluded.
Workbook package inventory inspected: no comments/named tables/custom XML/defined names or hidden dictionary sheets; no numeric values read.

Reporting Summary pinned, rendered all8pages as methods thumbnails; pages1/2/5 read in detail for repeated-measurement reporting, data access/exclusions and primary V3−V1 endpoint. No workbook numeric rows or trial efficacy results inspected.

The root-reviewed final source selection is frozen before numeric A:D row inspection. Committed freeze must precede numerical intake. This is not trial preregistration, untouched-source independent validation or clinical acceptance.

clarifications: CC BY4.0 is the verified Figshare workbook release license; each publication/registry source retains its own terms. All raw sources remain fetch-only in this repository.
Table4 covers source rows from all arms, including exploratory open-label BID; the audit does not claim every selected record belongs to the blinded comparison.
Positive finite numbers are raw numeric availability, not verified valid fasting assays.
Methods nominal24weeks with +/-5days is preserved separately from the workbook's6months label; no realized duration is inferred or converted.
draft_review.separate_Codex_source_critique: No blocking factual or unsafe-output finding after the listed clarifications; source hashes/headers/receipts verified without clinical outcome-row inspection.
